MCP Server 开发完整指南

一、项目概述

本文提供完整的 MCP Server 开发教程，包含：

  • MCP Server 基础结构
  • 工具开发
  • 资源暴露
  • Prompt 模板
  • 与 MCP Host 的交互

二、环境准备

pip install mcp

三、基础 MCP Server

3.1 Hello World Server

"""
MCP Server 开发完整指南
从基础 Server 到复杂工具开发
"""

import json
import asyncio
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Optional, Sequence
from mcp.server import Server
from mcp.types import (
    Tool,
    TextContent,
    Resource,
    Prompt,
    GetPromptResult,
    PromptMessage,
    SamplingMessage,
    ImageContent
)
from mcp.server.stdio import stdio_server


# ============== 基础 Server ==============

# 创建 Server 实例
app = Server("hello-mcp-server")


@app.list_tools()
async def list_tools() -> list[Tool]:
    """
    列出 Server 提供的所有工具
    
    这是 MCP 的核心接口，Host 通过此接口发现可用工具
    """
    return [
        Tool(
            name="greet",
            description="向指定的人打招呼",
            inputSchema={
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                    "name": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "description": "要打招呼的人的名字"
                    },
                    "language": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "enum": ["chinese", "english", "japanese"],
                        "description": "语言",
                        "default": "chinese"
                    }
                },
                "required": ["name"]
            }
        )
    ]


@app.call_tool()
async def call_tool(name: str, arguments: dict) -> list[TextContent]:
    """
    执行工具调用
    
    根据工具名称分发给对应的处理函数
    """
    if name == "greet":
        return await handle_greet(arguments)
    
    raise ValueError(f"未知工具: {name}")


async def handle_greet(arguments: dict) -> list[TextContent]:
    """处理 greet 工具"""
    name = arguments.get("name", "World")
    language = arguments.get("language", "chinese")
    
    greetings = {
        "chinese": f"你好，{name}！很高兴见到你。",
        "english": f"Hello, {name}! Nice to meet you.",
        "japanese": f"こんにちは、{name}さん！お会いできて嬉しいです。"
    }
    
    message = greetings.get(language, greetings["chinese"])
    
    return [TextContent(type="text", text=message)]


async def main():
    """主函数：启动 Server"""
    async with stdio_server(server_capabilitites=app.get_capabilities()) as (read_stream, write_stream):
        await app.run(read_stream, write_stream, app.create_initialization_options())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

3.2 运行 Server

# 直接运行
python hello_mcp_server.py

# 或使用 mcp CLI

四、高级工具开发

4.1 计算器工具

"""高级 MCP Server：计算器 + 时间工具"""

import math
from typing import List
from mcp.server import Server
from mcp.types import Tool, TextContent
from mcp.server.stdio import stdio_server

app = Server("advanced-tools-server")


@app.list_tools()
async def list_tools() -> list[Tool]:
    """列出所有工具"""
    return [
        # 计算器工具
        Tool(
            name="calculate",
            description="执行数学计算，支持基本运算和科学计算",
            inputSchema={
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                    "expression": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "description": "数学表达式，如 '2 + 3 * 4', 'sin(PI/2)', 'sqrt(16)'"
                    },
                    "precision": {
                        "type": "integer",
                        "description": "结果精度（小数位数）",
                        "default": 10,
                        "minimum": 0,
                        "maximum": 15
                    }
                },
                "required": ["expression"]
            }
        ),
        # 单位转换工具
        Tool(
            name="convert_unit",
            description="单位转换",
            inputSchema={
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                    "value": {
                        "type": "number",
                        "description": "要转换的值"
                    },
                    "from_unit": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "enum": ["m", "km", "cm", "mm", "inch", "ft", "mile",
                                "kg", "g", "lb", "oz",
                                "celsius", "fahrenheit", "kelvin"],
                        "description": "源单位"
                    },
                    "to_unit": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "enum": ["m", "km", "cm", "mm", "inch", "ft", "mile",
                                "kg", "g", "lb", "oz",
                                "celsius", "fahrenheit", "kelvin"],
                        "description": "目标单位"
                    }
                },
                "required": ["value", "from_unit", "to_unit"]
            }
        ),
        # 时间工具
        Tool(
            name="get_time",
            description="获取当前时间或进行时区转换",
            inputSchema={
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                    "timezone": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "description": "时区，如 'UTC', 'Asia/Shanghai', 'America/New_York'",
                        "default": "UTC"
                    },
                    "format": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "enum": ["iso", "human_readable", "timestamp"],
                        "description": "输出格式",
                        "default": "human_readable"
                    }
                }
            }
        )
    ]


@app.call_tool()
async def call_tool(name: str, arguments: dict) -> list[TextContent]:
    """分发工具调用"""
    handlers = {
        "calculate": handle_calculate,
        "convert_unit": handle_convert_unit,
        "get_time": handle_get_time,
    }
    
    handler = handlers.get(name)
    if not handler:
        raise ValueError(f"未知工具: {name}")
    
    return await handler(arguments)


async def handle_calculate(arguments: dict) -> list[TextContent]:
    """处理计算工具"""
    expression = arguments.get("expression", "")
    precision = arguments.get("precision", 10)
    
    try:
        # 安全的计算环境
        safe_dict = {
            'abs': abs, 'round': round,
            'max': max, 'min': min,
            'sum': sum,
            'pow': pow,
            'sqrt': math.sqrt,
            'sin': math.sin, 'cos': math.cos, 'tan': math.tan,
            'asin': math.asin, 'acos': math.acos, 'atan': math.atan,
            'log': math.log, 'log10': math.log10, 'log2': math.log2,
            'exp': math.exp,
            'pi': math.pi, 'e': math.e,
            'floor': math.floor, 'ceil': math.ceil,
            'factorial': math.factorial,
        }
        
        # 替换常用数学常数
        expr = expression.replace("PI", "pi").replace("π", "pi")
        
        result = eval(expr, {"__builtins__": {}}, safe_dict)
        
        # 格式化结果
        if isinstance(result, float):
            result = round(result, precision)
        
        return [TextContent(
            type="text",
            text=json.dumps({
                "expression": expression,
                "result": result,
                "type": type(result).__name__
            }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        )]
    
    except Exception as e:
        return [TextContent(
            type="text",
            text=json.dumps({
                "error": str(e),
                "expression": expression
            }, ensure_ascii=False)
        )]


async def handle_convert_unit(arguments: dict) -> list[TextContent]:
    """处理单位转换"""
    value = arguments.get("value")
    from_unit = arguments.get("from_unit")
    to_unit = arguments.get("to_unit")
    
    # 转换因子定义
    length_factors = {
        "m": 1, "km": 1000, "cm": 0.01, "mm": 0.001,
        "inch": 0.0254, "ft": 0.3048, "mile": 1609.344
    }
    
    weight_factors = {
        "kg": 1, "g": 0.001, "lb": 0.453592, "oz": 0.0283495
    }
    
    result = None
    
    # 长度转换
    if from_unit in length_factors and to_unit in length_factors:
        meters = value * length_factors[from_unit]
        result = meters / length_factors[to_unit]
    
    # 重量转换
    elif from_unit in weight_factors and to_unit in weight_factors:
        kg = value * weight_factors[from_unit]
        result = kg / weight_factors[to_unit]
    
    # 温度转换
    elif from_unit == "celsius" and to_unit == "fahrenheit":
        result = value * 9/5 + 32
    elif from_unit == "fahrenheit" and to_unit == "celsius":
        result = (value - 32) * 5/9
    elif from_unit == "celsius" and to_unit == "kelvin":
        result = value + 273.15
    elif from_unit == "kelvin" and to_unit == "celsius":
        result = value - 273.15
    
    if result is not None:
        return [TextContent(
            type="text",
            text=f"{value} {from_unit} = {result:.6f} {to_unit}"
        )]
    
    return [TextContent(type="text", text="不支持的单位转换")]


async def handle_get_time(arguments: dict) -> list[TextContent]:
    """处理时间工具"""
    timezone_str = arguments.get("timezone", "UTC")
    format_str = arguments.get("format", "human_readable")
    
    try:
        import pytz
        tz = pytz.timezone(timezone_str)
        now = datetime.now(tz)
    except:
        now = datetime.utcnow()
    
    if format_str == "iso":
        result = now.isoformat()
    elif format_str == "timestamp":
        result = str(now.timestamp())
    else:
        result = now.strftime("%Y年%m月%d日 %H:%M:%S %Z")
    
    return [TextContent(type="text", text=result)]


async def main():
    """启动 Server"""
    async with stdio_server(server_capabilities=app.get_capabilities()) as (read_stream, write_stream):
        await app.run(read_stream, write_stream, app.create_initialization_options())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

五、带资源的 MCP Server

"""带资源的 MCP Server"""

from mcp.server import Server
from mcp.types import Resource, Tool, TextContent
from mcp.server.stdio import stdio_server

app = Server("resource-server")

# 模拟知识库
KNOWLEDGE_BASE = {
    "python-basics": {
        "content": "Python 是一种高级、解释型的编程语言...",
        "mimeType": "text/plain"
    },
    "api-guide": {
        "content": "# API 使用指南\n\n## 认证\n所有请求需要包含 API Key...",
        "mimeType": "text/markdown"
    }
}


@app.list_resources()
async def list_resources() -> list[Resource]:
    """列出可用资源"""
    return [
        Resource(
            uri=f"kb://{key}",
            name=key,
            mimeType=value["mimeType"],
            description=f"知识库文档: {key}"
        )
        for key, value in KNOWLEDGE_BASE.items()
    ]


@app.read_resource()
async def read_resource(uri: str) -> str:
    """读取资源内容"""
    # 解析 URI
    key = uri.replace("kb://", "")
    
    if key in KNOWLEDGE_BASE:
        return KNOWLEDGE_BASE[key]["content"]
    
    raise ValueError(f"资源不存在: {uri}")

六、带 Prompt 模板的 MCP Server

"""带 Prompt 模板的 MCP Server"""

from mcp.server import Server
from mcp.types import Prompt, GetPromptResult, PromptMessage, TextContent
from mcp.server.stdio import stdio_server

app = Server("prompt-server")


@app.list_prompts()
async def list_prompts() -> list[Prompt]:
    """列出可用 Prompt 模板"""
    return [
        Prompt(
            name="code_review",
            description="代码审查 Prompt 模板",
            arguments=[
                {
                    "name": "code",
                    "description": "要审查的代码",
                    "required": True
                },
                {
                    "name": "language",
                    "description": "编程语言",
                    "required": False
                }
            ]
        ),
        Prompt(
            name="bug_analysis",
            description="Bug 分析 Prompt 模板",
            arguments=[
                {
                    "name": "error_message",
                    "description": "错误信息",
                    "required": True
                }
            ]
        )
    ]


@app.get_prompt()
async def get_prompt(name: str, arguments: dict = None) -> GetPromptResult:
    """获取 Prompt 模板"""
    
    if name == "code_review":
        code = arguments.get("code", "")
        language = arguments.get("language", "Unknown")
        
        return GetPromptResult(
            description="代码审查",
            messages=[
                PromptMessage(
                    role="user",
                    content=TextContent(
                        type="text",
                        text=f"""请对以下 {language} 代码进行审查：

```{language}
{code}

请从以下维度进行审查：

  1. 代码风格和可读性
  2. 潜在的错误和边界情况
  3. 性能优化建议
  4. 安全性考虑
  5. 最佳实践符合度

请给出具体的改进建议。"""
)
)
]
)

elif name == "bug_analysis":
    error = arguments.get("error_message", "")
    
    return GetPromptResult(
        description="Bug 分析",
        messages=[
            PromptMessage(
                role="user",
                content=TextContent(
                    type="text",
                    text=f"""请分析以下错误信息：

{error}

请提供：

  1. 错误原因分析

  2. 可能的解决方案

  3. 预防措施

  4. 相关代码示例"""
    )
    )
    ]
    )

    raise ValueError(f"未知 Prompt: {name}")
